findings.title: Notable successor path: field table `npcs[].replacedBy` vs `replacedNpc`
findings.text: V08 §2.4's npcs row (l.663) names `replacedBy`; the base key law (§7.7 item 12, l.12904), V08's own J-V8.76 and the research (mapping-verify V6, source line `replacedNpc: ousted.name`) name `replacedNpc`, holding the ousted notable's NAME. Under the closed-digest rule and T-V8-20's proxy check the adapter reads only keyList paths, so the successor link (F17) would never be read.
findings.fix: field-table row: read `npcs[].replacedNpc` (a name, joined to a carried notable by name); keyList and T-V8-20 follow
findings.evidence: CONFIRMED (documents read); the SF field name CONFIRMED by the research's source read

findings.title: Institution closure flag: field table `inactive` vs `_worldPulseInactive`
findings.text: V08 §2.4's institutions row (l.651) lists `inactive`; base §7.7 F2 (l.12944) and item 14's status rows key on `_worldPulseInactive` (mapping-verify V59, source lines). `inactive` is the DossierInstitution digest field, not the dossier path. The F1 flags `_worldPulseTierAdded`, `_worldPulseEconomyBuilt`, `_worldPulseFounded` are also unnamed by the row.
findings.fix: field-table row: name `_worldPulseInactive` and the three F1 flags; keyList follows

findings.title: Power key reads `factions[].id`, which the field table omits
findings.text: The key law `power:id:<faction.id>` when authored (base l.12903) reads `powerStructure.factions[].id`; V08's factions row lists faction, category, power, isGoverning, controlledInstitutions only.
findings.fix: add `.id` to the factions row (optional; absent at birth)

findings.title: Receipt F14's `_cutRoutes`, `_userRoutes` unnamed by the field table
findings.text: Base F14 (l.12949) reads `_cutRoutes`, `_userRoutes` and a route link; the research places them in the carried `config` (dossier-generation l.866). No field-table row names them, so the closed digest never reads them.
findings.fix: add `config._cutRoutes` / `config._userRoutes` rows (dating F14) or drop them from F14
findings.evidence: CONFIRMED (documents read); their exact location PLAUSIBLE until the final check

findings.title: Receipt F18 reads `decrees[]`, which no key list names
findings.text: Base F18 (l.12951) reads `decrees[]` with `tickRef` and the week's `decreeCauses[]`; `decrees` is a saved-settlement top-level key (dossier-generation l.622, 669) in neither requiredKeys nor optionalKeys, so V08 §3.5 step 3 drops it as ignored_key; `decreeCauses` sits in the campaign's pulse record, outside the dossier (item 125 (a)). F18 can never fire as designed; 'decrees first' ordering has no input.
findings.fix: add `decrees` to optionalKeys (read: true) with a field-table row, and drop `decreeCauses` (campaign state) from F18 - or rule F18 out

findings.title: Receipt F15's rename receipts and F20's memberBirths have no dossier path
findings.text: `rename-settlement`, `rename-faction`, `rename-npc` are SettlementForge's pending-edit queue kinds (dossier-generation l.538, 642), not named dossier fields; `memberBirths` is campaign state. A power or notable renamed in SF therefore always reads as removal + addition (rename_without_receipt).
findings.fix: state in F15 that only institution renames carry dossier receipts, or name the path the final check finds
findings.evidence: PLAUSIBLE (research describes them as edit kinds; the final check confirms)

findings.title: Receipt F13 `resourceEdits` and F10 `rawPower` unnamed by the field table
findings.text: The mapping's F13 reads `resourceEdits` (config-carried) and F10 `rawPower`; V08's rows read `config.nearbyResources*` and `factions[].power` only.
findings.fix: confirm F13 and F10's data rows name only field-table paths

findings.title: `institutionHistory[]` has no named join to its institution
findings.text: The row reads `tick`, `year`, `fate`; dating an institution's change (F1-F3) needs the entry's institution (name or id), which no column names.
findings.fix: add the join field the final check finds

findings.title: Reroll receipt F21 has no path
findings.text: V08 §3.11 re-binds notables 'on an absorb whose settlement shows a reroll (F21's receipt)'; no design text names the receipt's field.
findings.fix: name it, or define the reroll by the diff alone (same id, much new content)

findings.title: The ancientRuin marker's path is unnamed
findings.text: V08 §2.5 `history.ancientRuin` is read from 'the event that carries the ancientRuin marker'; the history row lists type, templateType, yearsAgo, severity, name, anchored, tick only.
findings.fix: add the marker's path (e.g. `history.historicalEvents[].ancientRuin`) once the final check reads it

findings.title: `neighbourNetwork[]` is read by the field table but named by no key list
findings.text: V08 §2.4 (l.659) reads `neighbourNetwork[]`; it is a saved/campaign TOP-LEVEL key (dossier-model l.51, 153) in neither requiredKeys nor optionalKeys, so V08 §3.5 step 3 drops it into `ignored` (ignored_key). Unseen in the 12 after-tick fixtures (V08 l.614-616), so T-V8-31 does not catch it; release row R9 would list it only once a fixture carries it.

findings.title: Root `destroyedByEventId` and `lifecyclePatch` are read but named by no key list
findings.text: The field table (l.672) reads 'the root's destroyedByEventId, lifecyclePatch' for DR38 and F20; neither is in requiredKeys or optionalKeys, so step 3 drops them. The research names `lifecyclePatch` as a world-pulse outcome kind (dossier-generation l.740), so it may not be a stored key at all; DESTROY_SETTLEMENT also writes a root `status: 'destroyed'` no row reads.
findings.fix: final check: name the stored root keys of death and resettlement; add them to optionalKeys
findings.evidence: CONFIRMED (key-list gap); the stored shape PLAUSIBLE

findings.title: Base §14's digest comment lists only file f's additions
findings.text: Base §14 (l.20943) says the digest gains V08 §2.5's fields and names file f item 509's set; file g's additions in V08 §2.5 (history founding/tiers/population/peakTier/lifecycle/ancientRuin, defence.readiness, traditions, conditions' crisis fields and forces, presentWeek) are V08's only. Harmless (V08 §2.5 is cited) but the comment reads as complete.
findings.fix: extend the comment's list or say 'and file g's'

findings.title: Custom record fields read vs present
findings.text: The field table reads 'the custom fields of V08 §2.8'; V08 §2.8 lists isCustom, customDefinitionVersion, customDefinitionFingerprint and customDefinitionCategory on the record, but the digest (custom part) reads only source, localUid, definitionId, revision, contentHash, category text, tags, description, required and the three scene tokens. The keyList must say which; T-V8-20's proxy check makes the difference observable.
findings.fix: field-table row: list the custom paths explicitly

findings.title: What a condition record requires is unstated
findings.text: V08 §3.5 step 4 quarantines a record lacking 'a name'; a condition's `label` is optional ('a missing label no name'), so the required field of a condition (its id? its archetype?) is not stated.
